notes.title: The Mara Witch
notes.notes:
Dear Mara Witch Fans,

I wanted to take a moment to express my sincere gratitude for your support and enthusiasm for The Mara Witch by wishlisting the game on Steam. Your excitement means the world to me and fuels my passion for creating this immersive experience. Thank you for being part of this journey with me. Together, let's make The Mara Witch an unforgettable adventure!

Warm regards,
Urban Gurus Team
